enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Sleep. Turn to stomach. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep.

Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Splash water on face. Apply soap to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk from bowl. Put down spoon. Pick up bowl. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check contents. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss project. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Schedule appointments. Update database. Print documents. File documents. Organize files.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose sandwich. Choose salad. Pick up drink. Pay at cashier. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Eat salad. Drink beverage. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Return tray. Walk outside. Sit on bench. Check phone. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Review notes. Type report. Make phone calls. Meet with colleague. Discuss program. Update budget spreadsheet. Send emails. Attend webinar. Take notes. Print materials. Organize event supplies. Confirm venue. Call vendors. Update social media. Reply to comments. Prepare presentation. Save files.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Enter apartment. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Take out pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil. Chop vegetables. Add to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water.

Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Empty trash. Replace trash bag. Wash hands. Dry hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Walk back. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Sit on bed. Remove socks. Stand up. Fold clothes. Place clothes on chair. Pick up pajamas. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Sleep.
